sloka: लक्ष्मणेन तु तद्वाक्यमुक्तं श्रुत्वा स राघवः ।सन्दधे परवीरघ्नो धनुरादाय वीर्यवान् ।रावणाय शरान् घोरान् विससर्ज चमूमुखे ।। ६.१०३.१ ।।
transliteration: lakṣmaṇena tu tadvākyamuktaṁ śrutvā sa rāghavaḥ ।sandadhe paravīraghno dhanurādāya vīryavān ।rāvaṇāya śarān ghorān visasarja camūmukhe ।। 6.103.1 ।।

translations.english: Courageous Raghava, the destroyer of enemies on hearing the words spoken by Lakshmana took up his bow and fixed it.
